raw_text: Pakistan Rangers have arrested former PM Imran Khan from Islamabad High Court premises. PTI supporters attacking military installations in Lahore and Rawalpindi. Corps Commander House in Lahore reportedly stormed. Internet shutdown likely imminent across Pakistan. Army deployment under Article 245 expected.
clean_text: Imran Khan arrested at IHC. PTI supporters attacking military installations in Lahore, Rawalpindi. Corps Commander House stormed. Internet shutdown imminent.
